chunks: When We give men a taste of Our benevolence they start rejoicing in it. When misfortune befalls them as a result of what they have done themselves, they begin to despair.
ai.seo_question: How do humans typically react to mercy and misfortune according to Surah Ar-Rum?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological duality of human nature, where joy in prosperity often leads to arrogance while hardship triggers despair rather than reflection. It serves as a reminder that true stability comes from maintaining hope (rajā') and gratitude (shukr) in both states, avoiding the extremes of complacency and despondency.
